additional_info.subject: Ghost session
ID0386335-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / RN 313405951025] Ghost Session in DC1 CRM:00797001353
additional_info.body:
Dear Furkan,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Sominath
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / RN 313405951025
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
RKKbvV
Problem Description
: Ghost Session in DC1
Troubleshooting
:
This is a known issue in FW v5.0.21, where the SECC stops working due to an internal crash during the charging session. Communication between Hi-Level and Low-Level is interrupted, and the SECC does not recover from the failure. The charging session count continues until the charger reboots.
Now the solution for this issue is to roll back to FW v4.0.11. Could you please confirm if the charger can be rolled back to FW v4.0.11?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0386335
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
